pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Patch size is largest on the mid-flank and significantly smaller and more densely packed on the lower neck and ventral areas.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored interstitial pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are frequent. Pathway thickness is variable, narrowing where patches are more densely clustered.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Extensive, confluent region of grey-brown textural disruption and hyper-pigmentation spanning the entire visible dorsal ridge and upper neck. Surface appears rugose and hypertrophic.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, dark, circular lesion is visible on the mid-flank. Multiple smaller, raised, hyper-pigmented nodules are scattered across the lateral torso.
other_distinctive_markers: Severe dermatological abnormality covering the majority of the dorsal half of the animal, characterized by extreme skin thickening and loss of normal pelage contrast.
